This stalk is found chiefly in cool temperate climates, especially in short-grass plains, and is best known throughout Endor. Even in suitable terrain, it remains extremely hard to find.

Carlong stalks are brewed into a decoction for shattered or severely broken bones. The injured area must remain completely immobilised for twelve hours: moving the limb may compromise the treatment. The plant is also known as Bursthelas. Repeated doses carry a particularly high risk of habituation.
